NPMS operates an SEC-registered alternative trading system (“ATS”) and acts as (i) agent on behalf of customers in facilitating primary and secondary transactions in unregistered securities of private companies (“private company security”) (ii) placement agent for accredited investors to purchase interests in affiliated and unaffiliated private funds, and (iii) paying and settlement agent for issuers and buyers and sellers in secondary transactions. SecondMarket Financial, LLC (“SMF”) is an SEC-registered investment adviser and a wholly-owned subsidiary of NPM. SMF provides investment advice on a discretionary basis to investment vehicles, including pooled investment vehicles that are offered to investors on a private placement basis (“private funds”). SMF also offers referral services to an unaffiliated investment adviser for individuals who receive cash proceeds from the sale of a private company security. NFSTX, LLC (“NFSTX”) is a member of FINRA/SIPC and a wholly-owned subsidiary of NPM. NFSTX operates an SEC-registered ATS and acts as intermediary to facilitate secondary transactions in private funds and other pooled investment vehicles.
